critical_code_review_comments: app/matched/[id].tsx picks the attempt card's CTA by (done, given, last): 'Result dekho' when the run is marked, 'Continue paper' when a run has some answers but is not submitted, 'Attempt again' when only a readLast() exists from storage, else 'Attempt all matched'. This maps 1:1 to the owner's ask.

src/matched/Pair.tsx keeps the shift list options-free: QuestionBlock is called without `rows`, so Options is never rendered (`list = rows && options.length > 0`). Confirmed in browser: 0 '-options' testIDs in the list.

src/matched/MatchedCard.tsx AttemptCard: matched-shift-count, matched-shift-count-line ('of 75 questions\nmatched with ours'), matched-shift-cup, matched-shift-fireworks, matched-attempt-facts, matched-attempt and matched-attempt-note are all present, exactly as the spec asks.
src/matched/paper.ts tally gives +4 for right / -1 for wrong / 0 for left; 4*4 + 2*(-1) + 0 = 14, which is what the UI shows.

app/matched/paper/[id].tsx stores progress in memory via runOf() + peekRun() and writes only the summary via saveLast() to browser storage ('matched.paper.<id>'): no HTTP write to /api/matched, confirmed by request tracker (writes array empty).
